queries.title: HTS codes or product descriptions
queries.description: Required unless datasetId is set. Mix HTS/HS codes (2-10 digits, dots optional, e.g. "8507.60.00", "610910") and product descriptions (e.g. "cotton t-shirts"). A code returns that line plus its sub-lines; a description returns the best-matching lines, ranked.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max lines per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Most HTS lines returned per query (1-200, default 10). For a code, the line itself comes first, then its sub-lines.

includeChildren.title: Include sub-lines of a code
includeChildren.description: For code queries, also return the lines under the code (e.g. all 10-digit lines under 8507.60). Default true.

statisticalOnly.title: Description search: leaf lines only
statisticalOnly.description: For description queries, return only lines with no sub-lines (usually the 10-digit codes used on an entry). Default false.

includeChapter99.title: Search Chapter 98/99 too
includeChapter99.description: Include special provisions (Chapter 98) and temporary or additional duties (Chapter 99) in description search. Default false. Code queries such as 9903.88.15 always work.

resolveAdditionalDuties.title: Resolve Chapter 99 references
resolveAdditionalDuties.description: When a line points to Chapter 99 (e.g. "See 9903.88.15"), add that provision's description and rate. Default true.

maxQueries.title: Max queries
maxQueries.description: Process at most this many queries per run (default 1000).

datasetId.title: Or: dataset ID from another Actor
datasetId.description: Optional. Read codes or product names from another run's dataset (e.g. a product catalog scrape). In an integration the triggering run's dataset is used automatically.

queryField.title: Field in that dataset
queryField.description: Field holding the code or product text (dot paths work). Leave empty to auto-detect: htsCode, hsCode, hts, tariffCode, productDescription, description, title, productName, name.

datasetMaxItems.title: Max values from the dataset
datasetMaxItems.description: Read at most this many values from the dataset (default 500).
